detail.title: Display module and electronic product
detail.abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a display module and an electronic product. The display module comprises an upper substrate assembly, a lower substrate assembly, a sealing frame adhesive, a linear buffer strip and display media, wherein the sealing frame adhesive is formed between the upper substrate assembly and the lower substrate assembly and circles a semi-enclosed display area, the sealing frame adhesive is provided with at least one opening, the linear buffer strip is arranged in the display area and is right opposite to the position of the opening, and the display area circled by the sealing frame adhesive is filled with the display media.
